Bank of America complaints recorded by the CFPB · submitted 1 May 2017 to 28 Aug 2023 · 62,516 records · AnalystLab Africa, Week 4

Complaints per month

Product distribution

Share of complaints by financial product

Timely-response status

Yes/No on valid records only; In progress shown separately
KPI definitions: Executive overview
  • Total complaints: count of records (Complaint ID is unique), after the active filters.
  • Timely %: Yes ÷ (Yes + No). Records with no Yes/No value (all “In progress”) are excluded from the denominator and counted separately; blanks are never treated as No.
  • Forwarding interval: Date received − Date submitted, in days. It measures CFPB intake-to-forward time, not company response or resolution time.
  • In progress: complaints whose company response is “In progress”. All are from 2023, so this reflects the data cut-off, not a backlog.

Product versus issue

KPI definitions: Product and issue
  • Product %: product count ÷ filtered total × 100.
  • Issue / sub-issue: consumer-selected categories. Issue_Std merges only two same-product wording variants. Sub-issue is blank for 17.4% of records because many issues have none.

Public response categories

Company’s optional public-facing response
KPI definitions: Company response
  • Response distribution: count and % by company response category (8 bare “Closed” records kept as their own category).
  • Public response: optional; most records show the company chose not to publish one, and 2,175 have none recorded.
  • Records marked Timely = No rise from June 2021 across several products; the data cannot explain why.

Average forwarding interval by product

Unusually long forwarding intervals

15 longest in the current selection; “long” = 30 days or more (the 99th percentile overall is 25)
KPI definitions: Timeline
  • Average / median interval: mean and median of Date received − Date submitted.
  • Long interval: 30+ days, an analyst-set threshold, flagged but not removed.
  • YoY change: compare only full years (2018–2022) directly; 2023 is 8 months.
Source: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, Consumer Complaints on Financial Products and Services (Bank of America), supplied by AnalystLab Africa. A complaint is a consumer-reported issue; it does not establish misconduct or a regulatory violation. Figures are computed live from the cleaned records and match the SQL KPI results.
